objective: Confirm the exact dense same-output specialization for the E3 metric-only (w=0) regime on an exclusive compute node, while retaining the factor-only representation boundary.

metric_only_specialized.description: In-place L and Aw update; omits v_w, v_z, and the identically zero outer-product correction.

generic_w0_ablation.description: The same extension and ownership as the specialization, but executes the general v_z recovery, zero-RHS forward solve, and outer-product correction.

drag_materialize.description: Propagate both thin factors and materialize their dense product.

fresh_materialize.description: Fresh Cholesky, two thin triangular solves, and dense materialization.

drag_factor_only.description: Propagate both thin factors without materializing Aw.

fresh_factor_only.description: Fresh Cholesky and two thin triangular solves without materializing Aw.

timing_order: Every repetition contains every path once. The six-path order is cyclically rotated by (seed + width_index + repetition) modulo six, so each path occupies every timing position exactly five times.
state_preparation: All mutable input cloning and reusable workspace preparation occur before each timed interval.
correctness_reference: Fresh FP64 Cholesky of G+zz^T followed by direct double-sided whitening of M=B C^T.
statistical_unit: One independently generated problem seed; repeat-level timings are summarized within seed and are not pseudoreplicated.
primary_estimands: Within-seed drag-plus-materialization median divided by metric-only-specialized median.
Within-seed fresh-plus-materialization median divided by metric-only-specialized median.
stopping_rule: Run every declared rank, width, seed, and path. Do not tune, filter, stop, or rerun based on confirmation outcomes.

pilot_context.role: implementation selection and crossover planning only
